steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan and let the cumin seeds sizzle.
Add the garlic, green chilli and a pinch of asafoetida and fry until the garlic just colours.
Add the onion and cook until soft.
Add the potato, turmeric, coriander powder, chilli powder, salt and a few spoons of water.
Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until the potato is tender.
Add the chopped spinach a handful at a time and stir until it wilts.
Cook on high for a couple of minutes to dry off the extra water.
Stir in the garam masala, squeeze over the lemon and serve with roti.
note: Both sources make a dry stir-fry, not the spinach gravy the old recipe was based on, so besan, tomato, ginger, ghee and bay leaf are gone and lemon is added. Spinach goes up from 50 g to 80 g, which is what both use.
